title: Understanding the Motion
text: The stone starts 45 m above ground, goes up, stops momentarily, then falls all the way to the ground. Total vertical displacement is -45 m (taking up as positive).

title: Setting Up Variables
text: Let up be positive. Then: u = +15 m/s, a = -10 m/s², and s = -45 m (stone ends 45 m below starting point).

title: Choosing the Equation
text: We need s = ut + ½at² because it contains s, u, a, and t. This will give a quadratic equation to solve for t.
